# `noisecov`

the noise covariance of a recording's good imaging channels over a span.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run noisecov --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run noisecov --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run noisecov --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording emptyroom --all [--block-seconds 10]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `name` | `--name` | `{recording}_noise_cov` | - |  | the stored statistic's name; its channels are <name>_channels |
| `channel_types` | `--channel-types` | `["MEG", "MEG MAG", "MEG GRAD", "EEG", "SEEG", "ECOG"]` | - |  | the channel types covered (only good ones: the recording's flags, else the montage's quality) |
| `block_seconds` | `--block-seconds` | none | s |  | the length of a block, its own mean removed; null: the span is one block |
| `remove_mean` | `--remove-mean` | true | - |  | remove each block's mean |
| `divisor` | `--divisor` | `samples_minus_blocks` | - | samples_minus_blocks, samples, samples_minus_one | the divisor: samples_minus_blocks \| samples \| samples_minus_one |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`meeg.noise_covariance`](../nodes.md) | x=recording | channel_types=$channel_types, block_seconds=$block_seconds, remove_mean=$remove_mean, divisor=$divisor | channels, covariance |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `channels` | kind selection, type indices, name $name_channels, on recording.manifold.0 |
| `covariance` | kind statistic, name $name, of recording, axes [{"name": "channel", "selection": "channels"}, {"name": "channel", "selection": "channels"}] |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE NOISE COVARIANCE OF A RECORDING (a statistic): the zero-lag second moment of its good imaging channels over the span the caller states (--from/--to or --all), read one
chunk at a time; blocks of block_seconds each have their own mean removed (null: the span is one block, one DC offset). The channels it covers are stored as a pick of the
recording's channels; the covariance's two axes lie over that pick. The whitener derived from it is an operator, made by the inverse.

  nxr-neuro run noisecov --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording emptyroom --all [--block-seconds 10]
```
